title: Mutation Intent
description: Internal schema used by the soc-autonomous-applier workflow. The meta-agent emits a mutation_intent for every change it wants to make to an autosoc-owned artifact; the soc-autonomous-applier workflow runs deterministic governance gates (kill-switch, ownership, budget, cooldown, loop-detection) against this shape, then dispatches the validated intent to soc-autonomous-applier-agent for snapshot + tool-based execution.

expected_ownership.description: What the meta-agent believes the artifact's owner is. The applier verifies against the registry before mutating.

new_definition.description: Required for op=create|update. The full artifact definition the applier will PUT.

patch.description: Optional partial definition for op=update. Applier merges with current state.
